episodes.synopsis: Yuu is a young boy who is a Healer, a special magic user who can calm the hearts of angry monsters. Merc is a young fairy creature who lives in a bottle. They're about to set out on a journey with Mr. Fluffball, a small fluffball creature, in this relaxing and easygoing adventure.
episodes.title: The Apathetic Boy and the Girl in a Bottle

episodes.synopsis: The crew sets off! It's a wide world full of adventure, and first up it's off to the village of the animal people, where a princess is being forced into a marriage she wants no part in.
episodes.title: The King of Dawn and the Imprisoned Bride

episodes.synopsis: The party arrives at the land of the fairies, where they're transformed into miniature versions of themselves. But even though they're small, there's big trouble!
episodes.title: The Tomboy Fairy and the Spring-Eating Dragon (Part 1)

episodes.synopsis: The group travels to meet the spring-eating dragon. In the process, they learn more about the forest and the fairy country.
episodes.title: The Tomboy Fairy and the Spring-Eating Dragon (Part 2)

episodes.synopsis: Yuu and his friends come to a small village where a princess is cursed. They try to help her break the curse and make her free.
episodes.title: The Red Star of Evil and the Brilliant Ruler of Superior Flame

episodes.synopsis: A girl gets lost in the mysterious world of dreams, as Yuu travels to the land of the dead.
episodes.title: The Lord with You in Dreams and the Town of Oblivion (Part 1)

episodes.synopsis: Yuu is trapped in the land of dreams, where he begins to remember his past.
episodes.title: The Lord with You in Dreams and the Town of Oblivion (Part 2)

episodes.synopsis: The party comes to the land of birds, where one's status is decided by the beauty of their singing voice. There, they meet a young girl from the countryside who wants to a diva more than anything...
episodes.title: The King of the Song Altar and the Diva in a Cage (Part 1)

episodes.synopsis: A new Diva has been born, and the old one has lost her voice. Now a creature beneath the city begins to stir...
episodes.title: The King of the Song Altar and the Diva in a Cage (Part 2)

episodes.synopsis: The wagon is traveling down the road when it's attacked by flying monsters, and Yuu and Merc are picked up and carried into the sky! There they land on a floating continent, whose inhabitants are less than friendly...
episodes.title: The Angel Who Couldn`t Fly and the Holy Wings of Ten Thousand Prayers (Part 1)

episodes.synopsis: Yuu goes to rescue Merc from the floating continent. Along the way, he and his new friend are captured by the palace guard, who have less than benevolent intentions...
episodes.title: The Angel Who Couldn't Fly and the Holy Wings of Ten Thousand Prayers (Part 2)

episodes.synopsis: Merc and Yuu are back home after their long journey. Merc thinks that Yuu was mad he spent so much time away from home, but Yuu has a special present for her...
episodes.title: The Healer and the Friend in a Bottle
